description: This file defines service functions for managing notes, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, listing, and tagging notes within a backend system using SQLAlchemy ORM and FastAPI. It contains business logic related to notes management, such as tag normalization and handling external API interactions.

methods.name: str _normalize_tag(name: str)
methods.description: Normalizes tag names by stripping whitespace and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: List[Tag] _get_or_create_tags(db: Session, tag_names: List[str])
methods.description: Retrieves existing tags or creates new tags based on provided tag names.

methods.name: Note _note_to_out(note: Note)
methods.description: Converts a Note ORM object to an output-ready Note object, with relationships loaded.

methods.name: Note create_note( db: Session, *, title: str, content: str, pinned: bool, favorite: bool, tag_names: List[str], )
methods.description: Creates a new note with optional tags and saves it to the database.

methods.name: Note get_note(db: Session, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its UUID or raises a 404 error if not found.

methods.name: Note update_note( db: Session, *, note_id: UUID, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None, pinned: Optional[bool] = None, favorite: Optional[bool] = None, tag_names: Optional[List[str]] = None, )
methods.description: Updates specified fields of a note identified by UUID, including its tags.

methods.name: None delete_note(db: Session, note_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a note identified by UUID.

methods.name: tuple[list[Note],int] list_notes( db: Session, *, query: Optional[str] = None, tag: Optional[str] = None, pinned: Optional[bool] = None, favorite: Optional[bool] = None, limit: int = 50, offset: int = 0, )
methods.description: Returns a list of notes filtered by optional query parameters such as search query, tag, pinned, and favorite flags, along with total count.

methods.name: Note set_pin(db: Session, *, note_id: UUID, pinned: bool)
methods.description: Sets the pinned status of a specific note.

methods.name: Note set_favorite(db: Session, *, note_id: UUID, favorite: bool)
methods.description: Sets the favorite status of a specific note.

methods.name: Tag rename_tag(db: Session, *, tag_id: UUID, new_name: str)
methods.description: Renames a tag identified by tag_id to a new name after validation.

methods.name: None delete_tag(db: Session, tag_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a tag and its associations.
